records.name: Plattenwühler Tiefrille
records.biography_en: Finds the important record just beneath the one everyone has already agreed matters. His HyperNorm crate stores the songs omitted from the agreed history. A dissonant card recognizes the sleeve without having been taught its importance. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Entdeckung liegt unmittelbar unter der kanonischen Auswahl.

variant_notes.note_en: Finds the important record just beneath the one everyone has already agreed matters.

records.name: Sessionfrau Taktsicher
records.biography_en: Has played the famous part often enough to stop asking whose name is on it. Her HyperNorm drum supplies the beat credited to a larger name. A dissonant card quietly writes hers on an otherwise blank margin. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der berühmte Einsatz wurde wie vereinbart namenlos ausgeführt.

variant_notes.note_en: Has played the famous part often enough to stop asking whose name is on it.

records.name: Tapegeist Unveröffentlicht
records.biography_en: Remembers a perfect take nobody is authorized to remember. His HyperNorm spool remembers a take that the catalogue marks absent. A dissonant card leaves space to hear it without pretending it was always known. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Aufnahme gilt als verschollen, nicht als vergessen.

variant_notes.note_en: Remembers a perfect take nobody is authorized to remember.

records.name: Rockstar Spitzenlage
records.biography_en: Would rather discuss the visible success than what is keeping it afloat. His HyperNorm trophy rewards the visible summit while the supporting work stays below discussion. A dissonant card asks what the plate is resting on. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Spitze steht für alles, worüber gesprochen werden soll.

variant_notes.note_en: Would rather discuss the visible success than what is keeping it afloat.

records.name: Mixmagier Untersignal
records.biography_en: Can make the missing part audible without convincing anyone to credit it. Her three HyperNorm faders balance an approved story against what the recording contains. A dissonant card asks her to leave the quiet part audible. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die fehlende Spur wurde zunächst nur hörbar gemacht.

variant_notes.note_en: Can make the missing part audible without convincing anyone to credit it.

records.name: Bootlegger Nebenspur
records.biography_en: Preserves what everybody insists should never have circulated. His HyperNorm cassette travels without the permission that might have erased it. A dissonant card asks who loses when nobody can listen. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bewahrung erfolgte außerhalb der vorgesehenen Verbreitung.

variant_notes.note_en: Preserves what everybody insists should never have circulated.
